# cachefly_edge_control_script (Data Source)

Reads a published edge control script of a service: the active version, or the version set in `version`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Active request script of a service
data "cachefly_edge_control_script" "active" {
  service_id = "681b3dc52715310035cb75d4"
  kind       = "REQUEST"
}

# A specific published version
data "cachefly_edge_control_script" "v1" {
  service_id = "681b3dc52715310035cb75d4"
  kind       = "REQUEST"
  version    = 1
}

output "active_version" {
  value = data.cachefly_edge_control_script.active.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Kind of script: `REQUEST` or `RESPONSE`.
- `service_id` (String) ID of the service.

### Optional

- `version` (Number) Version to read. Defaults to the active version.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the version was published.
- `filename` (String) Name of the file the version is stored as.
- `id` (String) Identifier in the form `service_id:kind:version`.
- `last_activated_at` (String) When the version was last activated.
- `script` (String) JavaScript source of the version.
- `script_size` (Number) Size of the script in bytes.
- `status` (String) Status of the version (ACTIVE or DEACTIVATED).
